title: Flat Headset: a phone in a Cardboard-style viewer as a 3D screen for the Linux desktop
description: Flat Headset is a planned way to use a phone in a Cardboard-style viewer as a 3D screen for the Linux desktop, without head tracking, through KDE Connect, KRdp and KWin's stereo outputs. Part of Sparky Stereo OS. This snapshot is the design; nothing is built yet. Licence: GPL-2.0-only OR GPL-3.0-only OR LicenseRef-KDE-Accepted-GPL, the licence of KDE Connect for Android.
